Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 144. Category: technique. Rank 3.

Rank 3 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 35 ki
Prerequisites: none
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: 30 feet
Chargeable?: No
Duration: Concentration
Type: Omni
Choose a target within 30 feet. The target must make
a Wisdom Saving Throw or be paralyzed as long as you
hold Concentration. As an action on their turn and at
the end of their turn they may attempt to make the save
again.
